title: Kenya Registers Record 3.6 Million Candidates for 2026 National Exams Under Tighter Security
description: KNEC will administer KPSEA, KJSEA and KCSE assessments to a record 3.6 million candidates, deploying smart padlocks, armed guards and intelligence-led measures to curb malpractice.
imageAlt: Kenya Registers Record 3.6 Million Candidates for 2026 National Exams Under Tighter Security

title: HELB Confirms Tuition Funds Sent to Universities for Five Student Batches
description: HELB says tuition funds for five student batches have been disbursed directly to universities, while upkeep payments remain under processing. Students can verify status through the HELB portal.
imageAlt: HELB Confirms Tuition Funds Sent to Universities for Five Student Batches

title: Mbale High School Appoints Manasseh Kagasi as Principal After Strikes Disrupted Learning
description: Mbale High School has appointed Manasseh Kagasi as principal after two student strikes disrupted learning and forced an indefinite closure, with stakeholders urging unity to restore stability.
imageAlt: Mbale High School Appoints Manasseh Kagasi as Principal After Strikes Disrupted Learning

title: Vihiga County Allocates Sh12 Million to Equip 200 ECDE Centres
description: Vihiga County will spend Sh12 million on chairs, tables and curriculum materials for 200 early childhood centres, aiming to improve learning conditions across all six sub-counties.
imageAlt: Vihiga County Allocates Sh12 Million to Equip 200 ECDE Centres

title: Heavy Rains Threaten Schools and National Exams in Vihiga and Western Kenya
description: Vihiga is among 43 counties forecast for above-normal rains, raising concerns over flooded classrooms, poor transport and possible disruption of KPSEA, KJSEA and KCSE examinations.
imageAlt: Heavy Rains Threaten Schools and National Exams in Vihiga and Western Kenya
